limitations: Applies only to alternating mixed-radix perfect additive complements; earlier unindexed equivalent return-time characterization cannot be ruled out. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_integrity: Infinite theorem supported by a self-contained digit-pair proof; finite cross-check is ancillary. The alternating mixed-radix construction, some equality examples, and the global sharp threshold are established prior results.
title: Exact minimal-excess times for alternating mixed-radix additive complements
